UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION FORM 10-K

Item 1. Business

We design, manufacture and market smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and related services. Our fiscal year ends in the last Saturday of September. We compete in highly competitive global markets across all of our product categories.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our business is subject to a variety of risks. Global and regional economic conditions could materially adversely affect our business and results of operations. Global markets for our products and services are highly competitive, and we are subject to substantial risks including component shortages, currency fluctuations, supply chain risk and cybersecurity risk. Failure to manage these risks could harm our financial condition. Additional risk factors include reliance on manufacturing partners and exposure to litigation risk in multiple jurisdictions.

Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments

None.
